raster.emulator:
openMSX 21.0
flavour: opt
components: CORE GL LASERDISC

calibration.source: openMSX RELEASE_21_0 src/video/VDP.cc and VDP.hh; installed _tas_tools.tcl
calibration.native_frame_epoch: machine_info VDP_cycle_in_frame, frame begins at VSYNC; no absolute-time modulo
calibration.vblank_definition: VDP status2 VR, checked against every endpoint; rising edge equals VSCAN IRQ edge

raster.method: Matched PC/SP routine entry/return breakpoints; original keyboard-only route until completion/game over; four warmup intervals discarded; native VDP clock snapshots and side-effect-free debug status2 reads
raster.limitations: Emulator only; routine endpoint includes descendants/interrupt time. clock_irq excludes hardware entry/vector. VBlank refers to VR, not a guaranteed safe VRAM budget. Line numbers start at physical VSYNC, not visible picture line zero. No actual original ROM or asset data exported.
